objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving with version control and approval workflows

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force)

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which document validity expires

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document becomes valid

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document that describes locally defined regulations or regulations relating to business processes

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed documentation of special work steps and procedures within a framework

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with main document and subject to own versioning

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document supplement not subject to release cycle or own release cycle

attributes.name: criticality
attributes.description: Low criticality, can be deleted directly

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Planned amendment to a document managed separately from content and version history

objs.name: template
objs.description: Pre-defined document structure that can be selected when creating new documents

objs.name: user
objs.description: System participant with assigned roles and permissions

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, Translator

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users assigned specific permissions and roles

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g. Reader, Archive)

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role responsible for creating and editing document content

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role responsible for checking document content for technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for approving document and deciding on distribution

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User role with permission to view approved documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role responsible for translating released content into other languages

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to verify document validity after defined period

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: Period of extended validity check (default 3 years)

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which document is archived (default 10 years)

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups assigned to receive document distribution

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Special user group retaining read access to archived documents

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initiate creation of a new document with selection of type and optional template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modify document properties, content or metadata

evts.name: upload_content
evts.description: Attach external files or generate new documents based on MS Office formats

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document to PDF format after saving

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group or person-specific read and change permissions to document

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate workflow step for reviewer to check document content

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and authorize distribution of document to readers

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply electronic signature to document as workflow participant

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make released document visible to authorized readers

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose amendment to existing document without affecting current version

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System generates request for validity check when 30 days before expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm document remains valid and update validity period

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Request to invalidate document that has no additional validity

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare document invalid and move to archiving status

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Revoke authorizations and store document for defined archive period

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate process to re-validate a previously archived document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore previously invalidated document to valid status

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to users when new document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request users to confirm receipt and understanding of document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User actively confirms receipt of document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated document content for accuracy

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish translated document version

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate new editing version when revising released document

o2o.description: Document is created based on optional template
Document has attachments that are released with main document
Document is supplemented with additional information
Change proposals are associated with and displayed in document
Validity extension request is linked to document for checking
Override request is created for a selected document
Reactivation request selects archived document for re-validation
Document maintains distribution list of users and user groups
User is assigned to user group
Author is creator and registered owner of document
Reviewer is assigned to document for content checking
Releaser is assigned to document for approval
Reader has read permission for document

o2e.description: User initiates creation of new document
User uploads external files to document
Document is converted to PDF format
Validity extension request is created for document
User with write access creates override request
Override request is created for document
User from Business Admin group creates reactivation request
Reactivation request is created for document
Document is distributed via email notification
New version of document is created
